provenance.method: Reviewed M3D-C1 Alfven normalization formula applied to live-run C1.h5 root attributes
provenance.reference_note: M3DNormalization documents C1.h5 root attributes b0_norm, n0_norm, l0_norm, ion_mass as the run normalization and defines v0=b0/sqrt(4*pi*ion_mass*mp*n0), t0=l0/v0.

review_scope: The conversion formula and committed DIII-D template values are reviewed. Template normalization is reference-only; the actual run normalization is read from live C1.h5 root attributes and used to derive the effective physical time scale. Explicit C1input/HDF5 disagreements remain fail-closed.
